source.description:
董梓甯的清新室內造型

Former 大學生了沒 cast member and 伊梓帆 leader 董梓甯 appears in a casual indoor setting, adjusting her ponytail while wearing a teal Reebok T-shirt. Her long brown hair is pulled back, and she sports light makeup that highlights her natural features. The neutral wall behind her and the soft, even lighting create a relaxed atmosphere that focuses attention on her poised expression and sporty-chic outfit.
